reason: The proposal offers no fixed target or independently semantic incompatible slot. Even with a valid slot, failure to separate from opaque controls cannot refute a role.

blockers.detail: The whole and all matched opaque controls can share the true role R and validly avoid the same incompatible slot. Their rates are identical although R is true. Opaque does not mean semantically negative. An analyst labels an observed structural slot process-only using inherited German renderings. An item can legitimately appear there under a different grammar or ellipsis; its occupancy falsifies the combined slot/grammar/role assumptions, not the lexical role alone.

all_of.detail: Fix whole W, claimed scope R, incompatible semantic slot S, construction and error assumptions; separate tests of the conjunction, power/capacity and mere control discrimination. Independently justify S before outcome access.

not_sufficient: More structural examples with inherited semantic slot tags.
